from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlowItem(BaseModel):
    """A single cash flow from investing activities entry found in a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period the data covers")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the cash flow line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported for the cash flow")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'in thousands', 'in millions')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text anchoring the data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flows: list[InvestingCashFlowItem]
